name: Kyowa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kyowa town emblem in navy: a ring topped by three short strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Kyowa, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted in 1955.

features.role: Kyowa town emblem — a ring topped by three short strokes
